reviewType: Independent narrow security/QA design re-review R2; no implementation or lifecycle approval
summary: PUB-R1-001 and the other cross-cutting R2 corrections are design-resolved. After the runtime peer report arrived, direct inspection of observationSanitizer confirmed one remaining shared blocker: the TrustedPolicy projection must preserve the existing 32-grant, unique-grant-ID and absent/present applicationPolicy loader contract. No additional architecture restart or later-story scope is required.

blockers.classification: Concrete frozen-design/source-contract mismatch, consolidated with the runtime peer finding
blockers.finding: Frozen R2 allows up to128 read grants, rule-ID reuse across distinct selectors and a required applicationPolicy object with boolean structural flag. Actual unchanged observationOptions accepts at most32 grants with globally unique IDs within the grant list; a present applicationPolicy must enable structural discovery. Field-only configurations instead omit applicationPolicy. The proposed projection can reject valid field-only policies or tempt a permission-widening default/loader change.
minimal_correction: Use applicationPolicy:null or the closed present object with allowStructuralDiscovery:true and readGrants bounded0..32. Null projects to omission of ObservationConfig.applicationPolicy, never a false-flag object or forwarded null.

Require policyRuleId uniqueness across the readGrants list independent of selectors, but preserve repeated IDs across otherwise valid field overrides where existing source permits them. Override testId remains unique.
Retain independent field-only rules and existing accessibleName/classification/eligibility validation. Align C1/C8/C12 without widening observationSanitizer/collector behavior.
required_oracles: Valid field-only config survives null-to-omitted projection; present false policy refuses and absence adds no discovery/read grant.
Valid application/region grant works without mandatory per-control mapping;33 grants and duplicate grant IDs with distinct selectors refuse.
Repeated field-override policy IDs preserve existing behavior; duplicate override testId refuses.
currentPolicyHash covers exact absent/present and complete effective grant/type/override semantics.

findingInventory.origin: Runtime peer report independently confirmed against actual loader before finalizing this review.

crossCuttingAssessment.assessment: AllocatedNeed now includes the server-issued bindingId alongside needId/producerStepId/consumers, and AcceptedTranslationPlan retains obligationId. This matches actual005 allocation/persistence. The full stored plan hash is preserved; the raw model schema remains unchanged and cannot mint IDs. Required bidirectional allocation/read/consumer joins reject missing, swapped, duplicate or forged IDs.

The original nonnull page target/document/generation0 remains in the exact action/proposal hash. Only observation FK, origin and derived locator use the genuine initialBlank null branch. The SQL iff plus required-key predicate and original bootstrap identity reject invented documents or observed actions missing observations.

crossCuttingAssessment.area: Complete configuration and effective policy transport
crossCuttingAssessment.assessment: ObservedJob now carries the full immutable configuration with configurationHash joined through binding/admission/launch/execute. Viewport is distinct from recording geometry; browser/environment/waitStrategy/runtime limits have no hidden defaults. TrustedPolicy now carries actual application/region grants, structural discovery, type allowlists and optional overrides, preserving current collector semantics without converting artifact locators into grants or requiring per-control mappings. The precise loader count/ID/absence conditions remain R2-POLICY-001; no change to current collector semantics is approved.

crossCuttingAssessment.area: Stable validation deadline under ownership renewal
crossCuttingAssessment.assessment: snapshotHash binds immutable captured validationDeadline and owner identity/fence, not the mutable lease expiry. Existing same-owner renewal only changes liveness; it does not change evidence identity, spend another claim, or extend/revive the original validation/grant deadline. The concrete real-renewal oracle resolves the earlier retained liveness concern.

crossCuttingAssessment.area: IPC status, stop, clock and recording truth
crossCuttingAssessment.assessment: PASS/FAIL/SKIPPED and nullable unexecuted timings now align with existing reporting. Unknown recording bytes stay null. The common closed Stop applies during account/launch/apply/run/drain. Recording/run-clock origin is established before account apply and merely echoed at Ready, so delayed setup cannot reset time or shift video evidence. Account AbortSignal and bounded cleanup/kill remain explicit.

The observed route is correctly assigned to existing /internal/** static Bearer-token/ROLE_STUDIO_RUNNER_CALLBACK protection, not guided-only certificate/JWT authentication. Protected production TLS/routing and the shared-service trust limit are explicit. RunnerInstanceId is a trusted-service CAS identity, not certificate evidence. Real filter-chain negative/positive tests retain separate persisted replay-grant/tuple checks; no permissive user-authority checker is introduced.

crossCuttingAssessment.area: Packaged execution profile/build versus learning history
crossCuttingAssessment.assessment: BuildIdentity explicitly binds packaged schemas/reference bundle, image association and Chromium build through a trusted release catalog and current execution/validation handshakes. A compatible new build is selected and pinned for a new execution without rewriting the immutable artifact. Historical model/provider/prompt/API facts remain audit provenance, nullable when not recorded, and cannot force unnecessary model relearning.

mandatoryImplementationOracles.coverage: D2/D3/C4/C12 now resolve original facts, blank target and enriched allocated-plan shape.
oracles: Use the actual005 implicit-reference flow to FINALIZING and accept its full persisted translationHash including binding IDs through independent Java/Node validation.

Original multipage/per-admission facts survive current-observation overwrite/restart; schema-valid wrong operation/guard/reference/edge/binding mutations fail against unchanged original basis despite recomputed local hashes.
Preserve the original acknowledged bootstrap snapshot, exact source-step order, full successful obligations/assertions and no missing/extra exercised work.

Real PostgreSQL scoped/null-safe/immutable/reciprocal deferred constraints, V19/V33 install orders, epoch/ABA/newer-head and older compile-result fencing, all transaction rollback points and one-winner concurrency.

Three validator sends maximum across keys/restarts; same-owner renewal during a real pending validation retains one claim and stable snapshot inside the original deadline. Changed owner/fence/source or expiry still refuses; no renewal or Core response extends authority.
Expected conflict commits without overwriting a concurrent receipt/cancel; unexpected SQL faults remain retryable and never create orphan readiness.

mandatoryImplementationOracles.coverage: C6-C8/C11/C12, D7/D8; no alternative replay pipeline.
oracles: Actual joined publisher/pure validator/ordinary recorded child: one learning submit, zero finalize navigation/read/mutation, two distinct fresh-value receipts with identical hashes and both gateway counters zero.
Exact configuration differs from recording geometry and is preserved; configuration/profile/build/policy mutation refuses before browser.
Region/application grants work without testId mappings; moved source, duplicate anchors, narrower deny/type change and sensitive descendants refuse.

Child values remain local/source-free with fixed diagnostics; real native versus isolated fill/select guards, cancellation, unknown outcomes, delayed account apply/video clock, SKIPPED remainder/null timings, unknown recording bytes and Stop are exercised.
Actual bean/route matrix for all four publication/replay flags; existing005 starts, historical receipt reads with flags off, old sessions without a base and compatible legacy runs remain correct.
Existing scheduler activation is never retargeted; actual processor refuses activation mismatch and explicit observed schedules lack unattended authority.
Benign model/provider/prompt/API changes keep compatible saved replay runnable; incompatible execution/build or explicitly revoked catalog refuses without fallback/recompile/model calls.

mandatoryImplementationOracles.coverage: C10-C12, D8 and all seven story AC tasks/File List.
oracles: Use real production Core/EvidenceRepository/Builder/Publisher/Readiness/Dispatcher/AdmissionCas/child entrypoint; only account connectivity may be controlled.
No hash-echo validator, fabricated compile/manual confirmation/replay record or later replay video as first-run proof; existing ordinary RUN/same-principal auto-accept remains unchanged.
Exact tested source/build/worker/profile and honest unavailable/live evidence; actual static service-token filter-chain tests rather than mocked controller identity or invented mTLS proof.

Receipt routing precedes active-session/account/canExecute guards. Original principal retaining current Core canRead after expiry/head edits reads immutable proof without validation, publication or effects.

Cached old owner or changed principal cannot override fresh Core denial/unavailability; UUID/digest, historical publication and current readiness remain separate; no cookie persistence or unattended refresh.

mandatoryImplementationOracles.coverage: C6/C7/C12 unchanged bounded user grant with accurate service boundary.
oracles: Fresh explicit-replay grants are execution/attempt/revision/scope/profile/build/account bound, at most 30 seconds until admission; queue/lock/retry cannot extend them.
Test the stated bounded Core-only revocation lag honestly; local cancellation/policy/account revocation and expired grant prevent new admission.

One-time account consume/prepare/apply/dispose on the same recorded context, sensitive handles absent from durable/text channels, lost setup ACK never retried, no account/Core/validator I/O under DB locks.

preservedDecisions: Separate uncached current Core receipt reads work after original session/worker/grant expiry without making new publication authority.
Current explicit replay has the documented maximum 30-second admission window and bounded Core revocation lag, no cookie persistence/unattended refresh/provisional fallback.
Result3/session-view3 preserve result2, expose actual UUID plus digest and separate historical publication from current readiness.
Learning/model/provider/API pins are immutable audit provenance, not accidental execution requirements; compatible replay never calls a model to revalidate them.
Only 007 account connectivity,008 automatic client/first-run recording,009 live benchmark and010 pilot remain their accepted later boundaries.
